forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, teams completed 1 visit. No zone surveys, technical surveys, clearances or zones declared free were recorded. So far, 10 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, 3 areas released and 1 cleared. The pilot has 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams active.

Officer attention: 12 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held; 1 report was queried. No new plan was approved; the current plan is P03. There are 570 suspected or confirmed areas still open.

The week 10 forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is already done, puts this season’s cleared mine areas at P10 to P90 of 10 to 14, and zones declared free at P10 to P90 of 10 to 14.
